metadata.title: DNS Resolver Availability and Resilience

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring DNS resolvers remain available, resilient, and predictable under fault, load, or attack conditions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: DNS resolver infrastructure, redundancy mechanisms, failover behavior, and degraded-mode operation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Defines availability and resilience expectations for DNS resolvers to preserve platform trust during disruption.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for operational guidance on DNS service continuity, failure handling, and recovery considerations as described in Section 6 (Operational Considerations). This guidance informs resolver survivability expectations, not performance architecture.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance related to Recovery objectives and Resiliency Techniques, emphasizing restoration of critical services without cascading failure, as described in Section 3.3 and Section 4.

metadata.remarks: DNS Resolver Availability and Resilience defines how DNS resolvers are designed and operated to maintain trusted name resolution during infrastructure failure, denial-of-service conditions, or dependency disruption. This pattern requires resolvers to fail predictably rather than silently undermine platform trust.

components.title: DNS Resolver Redundancy
components.description: Ensures multiple independent resolver instances are available to prevent single points of failure.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Denial-of-service attacks attempting to exhaust or disable DNS resolver infrastructure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Provisioning of redundant DNS resolvers to maintain service availability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS resolver services employ redundancy to maintain availability during component failure.

components.title: DNS Resolver Failover Behavior
components.description: Defines predictable resolver behavior when primary resolution paths or dependencies fail.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inducing upstream dependency failure to trigger uncontrolled fallback behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Resolvers transition to known-safe states under failure conditions rather than failing open.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS resolver failure modes are explicitly defined and exercised to preserve trust.

components.title: DNS Degraded-Mode Operation
components.description: Defines acceptable resolver behavior when authoritative resolution cannot be maintained.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Network denial-of-service conditions impacting external DNS dependencies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Defined degraded behavior that preserves correctness guarantees even with reduced functionality.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS resolution continues in a controlled degraded mode during extended disruption.
